plugin.name: tube-switch
plugin._long: Alt+Tab through the windows on the current desktop, minimised ones included.

option.name: activate
option._long: Opens the switcher, or moves to the next window while it is open.

option.name: activate_backward
option._long: Opens the switcher, or moves to the previous window while it is open.

option.name: inactive_alpha
option._long: How see-through the other windows are while you choose.
